## Load a skill into Claude

Download a `.skill` file below, then in Claude go to **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → Upload skill**. (ChatGPT accepts the same file.)

| Skill | Full version | Gem version (no scripts) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quiz Maker | `quiz-maker.skill` | `quiz-maker-gem.skill` |
| Itinerary Planner | `trip-planner.skill` | `trip-planner-gem.skill` |
| Crossword | `crossword.skill` | |
| Event Prep | `event-prep.skill` | |
| Money Plan | `money-plan.skill` | |
| Recipe Card | `recipe-card.skill` | |
| Chore Chart | `chore-chart.skill` | |
| Home Upkeep | `home-upkeep.skill` | |

Other platforms: `*-copilot.zip` for Copilot, `*-gemini.skill` and `*-gem.zip` for Gemini.
